exactCanonicalSetting.sourceClause: only subjects who had provided at least 2 weeks of consecutive data were used

inputBoundary: One caller-supplied finite duration in weeks for one participant, already adjudicated as the source's undefined consecutive-data span; continuity computation and stream selection occur before this gate.
outputBoundary: Exclude a participant below 2 weeks of source-defined consecutive data and retain equality or a longer duration.
limitations: The source does not identify which event, sensor, survey, or combined stream establishes consecutive data, so this binding does not select a stream.
The source does not define gap tolerance, required daily observations, missing-day handling, calendar-week anchoring, or duration precision.
Two weeks is not silently rewritten as fourteen complete participant-days; the caller must supply a duration already carrying the source-specific continuity adjudication.
A missing or nonfinite consecutive-data duration fails closed and is not synthesized from the study window.
The reported 111 eligible subjects are a cohort result, not a required output for an arbitrary fixture.
Raw Android and stress-survey parsing, participant linkage, feature construction, model training, and result reproduction are outside this eligibility boundary.
